rules.name: typefix-20261111-verify-dev
rules.sql: SELECT c.relname AS table_name, a.attname AS column_name, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS column_type FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid = a.attrelid WHERE c.relnamespace = 'opera'::regnamespace AND c.relname IN ('cloned_deal_ticket_table', 'deal_ticket_table', 'option_expiry_deals_table') AND a.attname IN ('premium', 'premium_1', 'original_lots', 'active_lots', 'lots_to_be_netted', 'netted_lots', 'broker_lots', 'price_1', 'price_2', 'spcl_rate') AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.atttypid = 'numeric'::regtype

SELECT v.col, count(*) AS values_still_cut FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c JOIN opera.typefix_20261111_src s ON s.business_unit = c.business_unit AND s.trade_id = c.trade_id CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES ('original_lots', c.original_lots, s.original_lots), ('premium', c.premium, s.premium), ('spcl_rate', c.spcl_rate, s.spcl_rate), ('active_lots', c.active_lots, s.active_lots), ('netted_lots', c.netted_lots, s.netted_lots), ('lots_to_be_netted', c.lots_to_be_netted, s.lots_to_be_netted)) v(col, now_value, legacy) WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND v.legacy IS NOT NULL AND v.now_value IS NOT NULL AND v.legacy <> v.now_value AND round(v.legacy::numeric, 4)::double precision = v.now_value GROUP BY v.col

SELECT s.business_unit, count(*) AS staged_trades, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.premium = s.premium) AS premium_equal_legacy, count(*) FILTER (WHERE c.original_lots = s.original_lots) AS original_lots_equal_legacy FROM opera.typefix_20261111_src s JOIN opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c ON c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = s.business_unit AND c.trade_id = s.trade_id AND c.is_latest_version = 1 GROUP BY s.business_unit ORDER BY 1

SELECT c.trade_id, c.premium AS new_premium, s.premium AS legacy_premium FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c JOIN opera.typefix_20261111_src s ON s.business_unit = c.business_unit AND s.trade_id = c.trade_id WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.is_latest_version = 1 AND c.trade_id IN ('TR-FY-2026-292041', 'TR-FY-2026-288367', 'TR-FY-2026-244400') ORDER BY 1
